actions.name: Space Sovereignty
actions.text: The Sovereign Harrier Boosts Thrusters twice, and if it moves at least 5 zones, it makes a Strike at a target in the direction of its current heading. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1-zone status penalty to Speed and a –1 status penalty to AC and Reflex saves for 1 minute.

actions.name: Speed Sigil
actions.text: See page 210.
actions.familyText: Frequency once per day; Effect The starship empowers its engines by activating a seven-pointed sigil. The starship gains a +2-zone status bonus to its Speed and a +1 status bonus to its AC and Reflex saves for 1 minute.

actions.name: magnetar rail
actions.text: (3-zone cone, analog, ordnance), Damage 1d12+3 piercing (DC 16 basic Reflex save)

actions.name: Deploy Turret
actions.text: The Vanguard Comet deploys a turret in its zone. The turret is a tiny starship object with AC 20, 10 HP, Hardness 5, and object immunities. The Vanguard Comet can only have four deployed turrets at a given time. If it would deploy a fifth, one of its previously deployed turrets is destroyed.

actions.name: Fire Turret
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect Each turret of the Vanguard Comet’s choice within sensor range targets a starship in the turret’s zone. Multiple turrets can’t target the same starship. The targets take 3d6 electricity damage with a DC 31 basic Reflex save.

actions.name: Mobile Aeon Turret
actions.text: The Vanguard Comet Boosts Thrusters and can move each of its turrets within sensor range 1 zone.

actions.name: Protection Sigil
actions.text: Resistance 3 (page 210)
actions.familyText: Frequency once per day; Trigger The starship takes damage; Effect A seven- pointed sigil blazes as divine energy surrounds the hull. The starship gains resistance against the triggering damage type equal to half its level + 1 (minimum 1) for 1 minute.

actions.name: Concealing Maneuver
actions.text: Requirements There’s a Medium or larger starship or hazard in the Vanguard Monitor’s zone; Effect The Vanguard Monitor gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against starships in a direction of its choice on the sensor map as it takes cover, and it attempts to Hide from starships it has a circumstance bonus to AC against.

actions.name: Lissala’s Eye
actions.text: DC 19 (page 210)

actions.name: Vanish From Sensors
actions.text: The Vanguard Monitor becomes invisible to other starships until the end of its next turn or it takes a hostile action, whichever happens first.

actions.name: Dominate Station
actions.text: The Sovereign Dominator’s sophisticated scanners scramble and break the battle stations of a starship within sensor range. The target starship attempts a DC 23 Will save. On a failure, all the target starship’s battle stations are malfunctioning.

actions.name: Issue Threat
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect The Sovereign Dominator opens a one-way channel with a starship within sensor range, then attempts to Demoralize each enemy creature on board the starship.

actions.name: Lissala’s Eye
actions.text: DC 23 (page 210)

actions.name: Sihedron Cloak
actions.text: The Sihedron Apostle is invisible to all non-Azlanti starships’ sensors. A creature helming a starship’s magic conduit can attempt to counteract the Sihedron cloak’s invisibility (7th rank; DC 34).

actions.name: Silence Sigil
actions.text: Starships within sensor range of the Sihedron Apostle must attempt a DC 32 Will save. On a failure, all magical and technological communications on board the starship cease to function. Comm units can’t send or receive data, and starships can’t Hack Comms. Crew members helming battle stations in different rooms can’t use normal ship communications. Telepathy and other communicative spells cease functioning. Creatures with innate telepathy from their ancestry or class features are temporarily blocked from psychic communication, receiving and emitting only vague emotional impressions from other creatures while in range of the silence sigil. A creature helming a starship’s magic conduit can attempt to counteract the silence sigil with an action that’s a magic conduit station action (7th rank; DC 34).

actions.name: Kurshudi’s Aim
actions.text: The Sihedron Apostle targets a starship within sensor range that it’s concealed from, choosing one of the ship’s battle stations to fire on. The target starship takes 3d8 electricity damage with a DC 31 basic Fortitude save. If the battle station is being helmed, the creature helming it can attempt the Fortitude save instead. Regardless of who makes the save, only the starship takes the damage and the battle station becomes malfunctioning as normal on a failure.

strikes.name: laser
strikes.damage: 3d6+14 fire (originates from a deployed drone within sensor range)

actions.name: Deploy Drone
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect The Klokworx Nexus deploys a magical drone in its zone. The drone is a small starship object with AC 30, 25 HP, Hardness 10, and object immunities. The Klokworx Nexus can only have four deployed drones at a time. If it would deploy a fifth, one of its previously deployed drones is destroyed.

actions.name: Laser Barrage
actions.text: The Klokworx Nexus’s numerous light laser cannons unleash a fusillade of fire. All starships in a 2-zone-cone take 8d6 fire damage (DC 35 basic Reflex save).

actions.name: Nexus Formation
actions.text: Frequency once per turn; Effect Each deployed drone within sensor range moves up to 2 zones.

actions.name: Nexus Swarm
actions.text: Each drone within the Klokworx Nexus’s sensor range fires at a target in its zone. Each affected starship takes 3d8+16 fire damage with a DC 33 basic Reflex save. If a starship is targeted by multiple drones, it rolls its save and takes damage only once, but it rolls its save with a –1 circumstance penalty.

actions.name: Ultimate Shock Cannon
actions.text: The klokworx Nexus fires a massive beam of crackling energy in a 6-zone-line in the direction of its heading. Affected targets take 20d8 electricity damage with a DC 35 basic Fortitude save.
